intro: The Innovation Club at IICE is a team of motivated students who want to help build the entrepreneurial ecosystem on campus. It gives student innovators a platform to show their potential, organises events for the students of IISER Bhopal and volunteers at events run by IICE. Its vision is to promote scientific entrepreneurship at IICE and to be part of the success stories of student entrepreneurs.

pillars.name: Culture
pillars.text: Students bring their project ideas to brainstorming sessions.

pillars.name: Conduct
pillars.text: Workshops, meet-ups and hands-on training in entrepreneurship and scientific technology.

pillars.name: Connect
pillars.text: Research conclaves and start-up competitions in the field.

objectives: To develop a self-sustaining hub for entrepreneurial sciences at IISER Bhopal.
To identify promising student project ideas and help turn them into pre-startups through the combined efforts of club members.
To promote innovative entrepreneurship among the students of IISER Bhopal.
